$comment: What a span of CompMD's own syntax is, written once for every grammar and the language server: each token's tree-sitter capture, TextMate scope and semantic token type (LSP's standard types; null where a grammar's colour is enough). Markdown's own spans keep their grammars' names. The test set (tests/) names these tokens.

component-marker.description: A component line's marker and its form's sign: `:::`, `::`, an inline component's `:`, a closer's `/`, a continuation's `+`, a slot's `#`

component-name.description: A component's name, where it is used, closed or defined (`component=card`)

slot-name.description: A slot's name on its slot line

param-brace.description: The braces around a param list

param-key.description: A param's key, and a flag

breakpoint.description: A breakpoint before a param's key (`md:` of `md:gap`)

param-class.description: A class param, `.wide`, with its dot

param-operator.description: The `=` between a param's key and its value, and the `:` after a breakpoint

param-string.description: A quoted param value, with its quotes

string-escape.description: A backslash escape in a quoted param value

param-bare.description: A bare param value, typed by the component's signature

expression-paren.description: The parentheses around an expression param; the CEL inside is its own language

definition-separator.description: The `---` line between a component definition's signature and its body

math.description: Math, `$x^2$`, with its dollars; the TeX inside is its own language

frontmatter-key.description: The frontmatter's `md` key, everything CompMD reads
